target_title: Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
quote: établit chaque mois un indice des prix à la consommation conformément aux dispositions du Règlement (CE) n° 2494/95 du Conseil du 23 octobre 1995 relatif aux indices des prix à la consommation harmonisés
basis: Règlement grand-ducal du 20 décembre 1999, Art. 1er: STATEC 'établit chaque mois un indice des prix à la consommation conformément aux dispositions du Règlement (CE) n° 2494/95 du Conseil du 23 octobre 1995 relatif aux indices des prix à la consommation harmonisés' [establishes monthly a consumer price index in accordance with the provisions of Council Regulation (EC) No 2494/95 of 23 October 1995 on harmonised indices of consumer prices]. Same shape as de-destatis-national-accounts -> esa-2010: a binding EU regulation supplies the definitions and methodology a national release conforms to, not figures. eurostat-hicp's own description states it is 'calculated according to a harmonised approach and definitions as laid down in Regulations and Recommendations' -- the same regulatory framework named here. Not extended to lu-statec-ipcn: Art. 1er says the IPCN merely 'se conforme aux mêmes principes et concepts méthodologiques' [conforms to the same methodological principles and concepts] as the IPCH, without itself being subject to Regulation 2494/95 -- a Research.1 §5a 'comparable with' shape, not a documented dependency, so no edge is drawn for the IPCN side.

target_title: IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS)
basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A, and structurally the strongest dependency in the Russian branch even though it is typed conservatively. The SDDS appears in the ENABLING PREAMBLE of a numbered, Minjust-registered Minfin order -- part of the legal authority under which the government-finance-statistics procedure is issued, not a methodological reference: «…постановления Правительства Российской Федерации от 26 сентября 1997 г. № 1226 "О присоединении Российской Федерации к Специальному стандарту распространения данных МВФ" …, в целях совершенствования методологии формирования информации по статистике государственных финансов п р и к а з ы в а ю:». The standard's full Russian name appears verbatim in the order's own text, so the requirement that the dependent document name the standard itself is satisfied, even though the immediate instrument cited is the 1997 Government Resolution effecting accession. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on` DELIBERATELY: the SDDS here supplies legal authority and a transmission obligation (the Порядок §22 requires Treasury transmission «в Международный валютный фонд» on a fixed timetable), while the compilation METHOD the order actually prescribes is described only by unversioned reference to «руководствами по распространению (раскрытию) данных» -- so a methodology-typed edge would overstate what this document says. A TENSE/EVENT NOTE worth preserving: Постановление № 1226 is dated 1997 while Rosstat's GDP procedure gives Russia's SDDS accession as 31 January 2005. These are two different events -- the 1997 resolution authorises accession, 2005 is the subscription date -- and they are not contradictory.
